title: Digest
description: Summary, chapters, and key points of one transcript.

source.description: The URL or file path the transcript came from.

transcriptPath.description: Absolute path of the transcript file the digest was made from.

model.description: The model that wrote the digest.

summary.description: One paragraph on what the recording says.

chapters.description: Sections of the recording in order.

start.description: Start time in seconds, taken from a transcript segment.

keyPoints.description: The claims, facts, or steps worth remembering.

visual.description: What appears on screen, in order. Only a digest made with image notes has it.

start.description: Time in seconds, taken from an image note.

costUsd.description: Model spend of this call. Zero on a cache hit.
